model_annotation: The graph illustrates the F1 score performance of three different models—lattice, FLAT, and OURS—over a series of training epochs. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, ranging from 0 to 18, with tick marks at intervals of 2, and is labeled "epoch (次)". The y-axis represents the F1 score, ranging from 0.55 to 0.90, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05, and is labeled "F1分数". The plot displays three distinct lines: the red line with square markers represents the lattice model, which starts at an F1 score of approximately 0.59 at epoch 2 and increases sharply to about 0.81 at epoch 8, then continues to rise more gradually to approximately 0.85 at epoch 16. The blue line with circular markers represents the FLAT model, beginning at an F1 score of about 0.79 at epoch 2, increasing to approximately 0.86 at epoch 8, and then rising more slowly to about 0.88 at epoch 16. The yellow line with triangular markers represents the OURS model, starting at an F1 score of approximately 0.82 at epoch 2, increasing to about 0.88 at epoch 8, and continuing to rise to approximately 0.90 at epoch 16. All three models show an increasing trend in F1 score as the number of epochs increases.
